newsitem.title: USA: UBS analyst says Citicorp a top bank pick in U.S..
newsitem.headline: UBS analyst says Citicorp a top bank pick in U.S..

text.p: NEW YORK, April 29 (Reuter) UBS Securities banking Analyst Thomas Hanley told a panel on global stock picking Tuesday that his favorite U.S. bank stocks are Citicorp among the money centers banks and NationsBank Corp among the super regionals.
He cited Citicorp for strong management and its use of technology. The analyst noted that Citicorp and NationsBank have been favorites in the past.
As for U.S. bank stocks in general, he said first-quarter earnings reported by U.S. banks during mid-April were "very very solid.

Referring to the U.S. economic environment, Hanley said he sees moderation in the second half of 1997 and the first half of 1998 but he is concerned there will be a pickup in the latter part of 1998 and 1999 that may be more difficult to deal with.

John Aitken, UBS Securities managing director, in discussing U.K. banking stocks, said top picks were Lloyds Bank Plc and Abbey National Plc while National Westminster Bank Plc could be a choice for investors who are "really brave."
Aitken said U.K. banks have been through the best part of the cycle and the sector should not be overweighted.
